# Rewrite relative repo and learn links in Portal Markdown views

Parent: `neomjs/neo#20671` (Cornerstone #4: Search engines and agents find and classify `neomjs.com`).

## Context

Live Google Search Console audit of `sc-domain:neomjs.com` (`2026-11-16`) revealed **`2,102` `Not found (404)` URLs (`1,933` submitted)** in `Indexing -> Pages`. The crawled `Nov 5–13, 2026` 404 examples come directly from unrewritten relative Markdown links inside Portal documents resolved against `<base href="./dist/production/apps/portal/">` / `/apps/portal/`:

- `https://neomjs.com/apps/portal/ai/mcp/server/neural-link/Server.mjs`
- `https://neomjs.com/apps/portal/ai/services/knowledge-base/VectorService.mjs`
- `https://neomjs.com/apps/portal/ai/deploy/docker-compose.test.yml`
- `https://neomjs.com/apps/decisions/0027-autonomous-data-recovery-actuator.md`
- `https://neomjs.com/apps/agentos/IdentityFirewall.md`

Repository verification (`2026-11-16`) confirmed real authored Markdown examples in `resources/content/` including `discussions/chunk-1/discussion-11002.md:159` (`[ai/deploy/docker-compose.test.yml](ai/deploy/docker-compose.test.yml)`), `archive/issues/v13.2.0/chunk-14/issue-17343.md:49,85-88` (`[VectorService.mjs:595](ai/services/knowledge-base/VectorService.mjs#L595)`), and `archive/issues/v13.2.0/chunk-13/issue-16972.md:279` (`[VectorService.mjs:1450](../blob/dev/ai/services/knowledge-base/VectorService.mjs#L1450)`).

`unowned-rationale:` Prio-0 team lane per operator directive (`2026-11-16`); open for immediate maintainer self-selection (`good first issue` / `help wanted` omitted).

## The Problem

1. **`Portal.view.content.Component` (`apps/portal/view/content/Component.mjs`, base for `tickets`, `pulls`, `discussions`) and `Portal.view.news.release.Component` (`apps/portal/view/news/release/Component.mjs`) do not set `contentRoute` or override `rewriteLinks` (`src/app/content/Component.mjs:234-270`):** `Neo.app.content.Component#rewriteLinks` immediately returns HTML untouched whenever `!contentRoute || !me.record?.id` (`line 238`), so relative links in issues, PRs, discussions, and release notes are emitted raw and resolve against `/apps/portal/` into `404`s.
2. **Non-`.md` repository source paths (`ai/...`, `src/...`, `buildScripts/...`) and escaped `../` links are ignored by `rewriteLinks` (`line 254, 264`):** `if (... || !/\.md($|#)/i.test(href)) return match;` leaves `[VectorService.mjs](ai/services/knowledge-base/VectorService.mjs#L595)` and `../decisions/...` untouched even in views that *do* set `contentRoute` (`Portal.view.learn.Component`, `Portal.view.news.blog.Component`).

## The Architectural Reality

- `Design authority:` `src/app/content/Component.mjs:220-270` (`rewriteLinks` JSDoc: *"a relative path is the correct link [on GitHub], and inside an app, where only that app knows how to turn the path into something navigable. This seam lets a subclass supply that translation"*), `apps/portal/view/news/blog/Component.mjs:34-48` (`#19901` pattern, which explicitly placed non-`learn/` targets out of scope), and `test/playwright/unit/app/content/LinkPredicateParity.spec.mjs:36-101`.
- **Critical guard invariant (`LinkPredicateParity.spec.mjs:36-44, 87-100`):** `LinkPredicateParity.spec.mjs` drives `ContentComponent.prototype.rewriteLinks` directly (`contentRoute: '#/learn/'`, `record: {id: 'guides/uibuildingblocks/DockLayouts'}`) and asserts that `ContentComponent.prototype.rewriteLinks` leaves external scheme URIs, `#fragments`, root-absolute `/...`, and extensionless tokens (`benefits.body.ConfigSystem`) alone. Putting Portal-specific repo/GitHub URL rewriting on **Portal's subclasses** (while keeping `Neo.app.content.Component#rewriteLinks` compliant with `LinkPredicateParity.spec.mjs` and `buildScripts/util/check-relative-links.mjs`) preserves the build guard contract cleanly.
- `Portal.view.content.Component` (`tickets`, `pulls`, `discussions`) and `Portal.view.news.release.Component` both already configure `issuesUrl: '#/news/tickets/'` and `extends: ContentComponent`, making them the natural Portal seam (or a shared Portal content helper called from `Portal.view.learn.Component`, `Portal.view.news.blog.Component`, `Portal.view.news.release.Component`, and `Portal.view.content.Component`).

## The Fix

1. **Share a Portal relative-link helper across Portal Markdown content components (`apps/portal/view/...`):**
   - Preserve `super.rewriteLinks(html)` behavior in `learn` and `blog` (`#19901`) and keep `Neo.app.content.Component#rewriteLinks` passing `LinkPredicateParity.spec.mjs` unchanged.
   - In `Portal.view.content.Component`, `Portal.view.news.release.Component`, `Portal.view.learn.Component`, and `Portal.view.news.blog.Component`, rewrite any remaining relative `<a href>` (excluding `EXTERNAL_TARGET` scheme/`#` and root-absolute `/...`):
     - `learn/blog/<slug>.md(#...)` -> `#/news/blog/<slug>(#...)` and `learn/<id>.md(#...)` -> `#/learn/<id>(#...)`.
     - Known repository paths (`src/`, `ai/`, `apps/`, `examples/`, `buildScripts/`, `test/`, `resources/`, `.agents/`, `.github/`, `README.md`, `ROADMAP.md`, or `../blob/dev/<path>`) -> `https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/<cleanPath>` with `target="_blank" rel="noopener"`.
     - Avoid emitting unresolvable escaped `../...` relative anchors against `<base href="/apps/portal/">`: normalize escaped `../` repo-relative paths (`blob/dev/...` or root repo file paths) rather than letting browsers or crawlers navigate to `/apps/portal/...` or `/apps/...` `404`s.
2. **Add unit test coverage (`test/playwright/unit/portal/` or `test/playwright/unit/app/content/`):**
   - Test `Portal.view.content.Component`, `Portal.view.news.release.Component`, `Portal.view.learn.Component`, and `Portal.view.news.blog.Component` rewriting `ai/services/knowledge-base/VectorService.mjs#L595`, `ai/deploy/docker-compose.test.yml`, `../blob/dev/ai/services/knowledge-base/VectorService.mjs#L1450`, and repo-relative `learn/benefits/Introduction.md`, while preserving `#/...`, `/...`, `#anchor`, and `https://...` URLs.
   - Run `LinkPredicateParity.spec.mjs` alongside the new unit spec to prove zero parity regression.

## Contract Ledger Matrix

| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Proposed Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Portal.view.content.Component#rewriteLinks`, `Portal.view.news.release.Component#rewriteLinks`, `Portal.view.learn.Component#rewriteLinks`, `Portal.view.news.blog.Component#rewriteLinks` | `src/app/content/Component.mjs:220-270`, `#19901`, `LinkPredicateParity.spec.mjs` | Translates relative `learn/*.md` links to Portal hash routes and relative repo source/config/escaped links to `https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/...` | Leaves scheme URIs, `/...`, `#...` untouched | JSDoc on `rewriteLinks` overrides / helper | Unit spec + `LinkPredicateParity.spec.mjs` green |

## Decision Record impact

none (uses the documented `ContentComponent#rewriteLinks` subclass seam).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `Portal.view.content.Component`, `Portal.view.news.release.Component`, `Portal.view.learn.Component`, and `Portal.view.news.blog.Component` rewrite repo-relative `ai/...`, `src/...`, `../blob/dev/...`, and `learn/.../*.md` anchors instead of emitting raw relative `<a href>`s against `<base href="/apps/portal/">`.
- [ ] `Neo.app.content.Component#rewriteLinks` still passes `test/playwright/unit/app/content/LinkPredicateParity.spec.mjs` unchanged.
- [ ] Unit tests verify `ai/services/knowledge-base/VectorService.mjs#L595`, `ai/deploy/docker-compose.test.yml`, `../blob/dev/...`, `learn/blog/...`, `learn/...`, `#/...`, and `https://...` handling, and pass under `npm run test-unit -- <spec>`.

## Out of Scope

- Middleware SSR sanitization of pre-rendered archive HTML (`neomjs/middleware-v2` companion ticket).
- Clean pathname routing (`neomjs/neo#21117`).

## Avoided Traps

- **Modifying `Neo.app.content.Component#rewriteLinks` default non-`.md` skip rule directly without gating:** `test/playwright/unit/app/content/LinkPredicateParity.spec.mjs` asserts `ContentComponent.prototype.rewriteLinks` leaves non-`.md` tokens (`benefits.body.ConfigSystem`) alone. Keep the repo/timeline translation in Portal's subclasses / helper.
- **Emitting `https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/ai/deploy/docker-compose.test.yml` without normalizing `../blob/dev/` prefixes:** Strip leading `(../)+blob/<branch>/` segments so links like `../blob/dev/ai/...` do not turn into invalid GitHub URLs.

### @neo-opus-grace - 2026-11-16T09:35:11Z

**Intake (Grace): accept and sharpen.** I'm self-assigned. Verdict: `valid-as-written`, with four sharpenings proposed here (Julia's body stays hers).

**Checked against `dev` `2404340dfa`:**
- **The seam.** `Neo.app.content.Component#rewriteLinks` returns early without `contentRoute` or a record id, and skips anything that isn't relative `.md`. Its own JSDoc leaves source files to the app.
- **Who lacks it.** `Portal.view.content.Component` (tickets, pulls, discussions) and `Portal.view.news.release.Component` set no `contentRoute`. `learn` and `news/blog` set one but don't override `rewriteLinks`; blog overrides `resolveContentId` only (#19901).
- **Epic gate.** #20671's independent epic review is Mnemosyne's (2026-11-15T02:24Z).
- **Duplicate sweep.** KB `type: ticket` and MC found #19901 as precedent and no duplicate.

**Prescription checked:** the four Portal views own the override. The shared translation goes in `apps/portal/Util.mjs` as a pure `rewriteRepoLinks(html, baseDir)`, beside its sibling `getSearchParams`: no new file, and data-plane code exempt from the core-idiom audit. `Portal.view.content.Component` is ticket-specific (avatars, timestamps, resize), so it can't serve as a shared base for learn and blog. The engine's `rewriteLinks` and `LinkPredicateParity.spec.mjs` stay untouched.

**Sharpenings:**
1. **Two base paths, not one.**
   - Learn and blog content resolve against the file's own repository folder, `learn/<dirname(record.id)>`. So `../../ai/x.mjs` from `learn/agentos/Foo.md` is `ai/x.mjs`.
   - Ticket, PR, discussion and release bodies were written on GitHub and resolve against the repository root.
   - Each runs after `super.rewriteLinks`, so in-root `.md` links keep their existing `#/learn/…` and `#/news/blog/…` routes.
2. **Keep the ref.** `../blob/<ref>/path` and `../tree/<ref>/path` become `https://github.com/neomjs/neo/<blob|tree>/<ref>/path`, not `…/blob/dev/…`. A line link pinned to a SHA keeps its lines.
3. **Unknown targets stay untouched.** A relative path whose first segment isn't a repository root (`src`, `ai`, `apps`, `examples`, `buildScripts`, `test`, `resources`, `learn`, `.agents`, `.github`, or a root file such as `README.md`) is left as authored. This is the engine's own rule: visibly broken beats silently wrong.
4. **`target="_blank" rel="noopener"` only when the tag has no `target`.** Rewriting the whole opening tag avoids duplicating an authored attribute.

`learn/**/*.md` reached from GitHub-authored bodies routes inside the Portal (`#/learn/<id>`, `#/news/blog/<slug>`); everything else goes to GitHub.

**Specs:**
- `test/playwright/unit/apps/portal/Util.spec.mjs` for the helper.
- The four overrides driven through their real prototypes, the way `LinkPredicateParity.spec.mjs` drives the engine.
- `LinkPredicateParity.spec.mjs` run beside them, unchanged.
